title: The Slow Undertow
author: Hazel Ishikawa
blurb: Xanthe Montrose, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
